scope: Settings has one desktop widget switch and a widget checklist. Calendar, Analog Clock and Photos are selected by default.

checks.command: KDE neon disposable VM, Golden Gate defaults: opened Settings > Widgets. Installed the selected bundled packages into an isolated guest data directory, changed the selection, reinstalled it, then removed the managed packages.

coverage_limits: Golden Gate supplied the VM capture. Both editions exercised wizard navigation offscreen. Guest package lifecycle ran against the bundled archive in an isolated directory. Desktop applet placement was not exercised in this lifecycle check.
